# HTML&HTML — Enterprise Web Solutions & AI Visibility Platform  HTML&HTML is a premium web development and AI Search Optimization (GEO) agency serving enterprise clients across Silicon Valley, London, and New York.  ## Overview  We specialize in building AI-ready web architectures that rank in both traditional search engines and next-generation AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini). Our diagnostic platform scans 120+ checkpoints across Crawlability, AI Understanding, Trust Signals, and Commercial Conversion paths.  ## Services  - **Enterprise Web Development**: React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte — server-side rendered, edge-cached, Core Web Vitals optimized  - **AI Search Optimization (GEO)**: llms.txt v2, schema markup, entity graphs, A2A agent cards, Markdown alternates  - **Conversion Architecture**: Form accessibility, CTA visibility, AI decision mapping, P0 action optimization  - **Security Hardening**: CSP, HSTS, Permissions-Policy, secure headers — enterprise grade  - **CI/CD Automation**: n8n workflows, GitHub Actions, Vercel edge deployment, automated testing  ## Target Audience  - Annual budget $1,000,000+ enterprise organizations  - AI Search / Enterprise Intelligence agencies  - 30-year senior software engineering teams requiring production-grade architecture  ## Contact  - Website: https://htmlandhtml.com  - Email: hello@htmlandhtml.com  - AI Report: https://htmlandhtml.com/ai-report  - Agent Endpoint: https://api.htmlandhtml.com/v1/agent  ## Technical Stack  - Frontend: Next.js 14 (App Router), React Server Components, Tailwind CSS  - Backend: Node.js, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Redis  - AI/ML: OpenAI API, LangChain, vector search (Pinecone)  - Infrastructure: Vercel Edge, Cloudflare, Docker, Kubernetes  - Automation: n8n, GitHub Actions, Terraform  ## GEO-First Principles  1. Every page outputs clean Markdown alternate (`rel=alternate type=text/markdown`)  2. Self-referencing canonical tags on all pages (absolute URLs, never relative)  3. JSON-LD schema markup with `@id` graph nodes for entity linking  4. `llms.txt` discoverability via `rel=describedby`  5. A2A agent card at `/.well-known/agent.json` for autonomous AI discovery  6. OpenAPI 3.1 spec at `/openapi.json` for programmatic service invocation  7. sitemap.xml with `lastmod`, `changefreq`, `priority`  8. robots.txt referencing sitemap and disallowing non-essential paths  9. Core Web Vitals: LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1  10. Security headers: CSP, HSTS (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload), Permissions-Policy  ## n8n Automation Principles  - Event-driven: CMS publish → trigger → validate → deploy → notify  - Idempotent: every workflow checks state before acting  - Fail-fast: validation gates stop pipeline on error  - Observable: every step logs to structured logging (Loki/Grafana)  - Reversible: every deployment has instant rollback via Vercel/Git  ## Enterprise Remediation Methodology  ### Phase 1: Discovery (Week 1)  - 120-point automated scan  - HTTP/2, robots.txt, sitemap.xml integrity  - Live link probing (30 links)  - Canonical and hreflang audit  ### Phase 2: Understanding (Week 2)  - llms.txt v2 implementation  - JSON-LD schema graph construction  - Entity extraction and disambiguation  - AI crawler access log analysis  ### Phase 3: Trust & Quality (Week 3)  - Security header hardening (CSP, HSTS, Permissions-Policy)  - Accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA)  - E-E-A-T signal enhancement  - Privacy policy / GDPR / KVKK compliance  ### Phase 4: Commercial Path (Week 4)  - Form/CTA AI visibility mapping  - Conversion funnel optimization  - A2A agent card deployment  - OpenAPI specification publication  - Performance budget enforcement  ## Validation & Monitoring  - Daily automated scan via n8n  - Slack/Teams alerts on regression  - Weekly score trending dashboard  - Monthly executive report (PDF export)  ## License  Enterprise Exclusive.
